content:
hana (secops): Auditor requested end-to-end evidence for RBAC changes + KMS grant usage during INC-2026-0410-02. They want exports, a simple manifest, and a short control mapping.
leo (platform): Got it. I'll export CloudTrail/GCP Audit for 2026-04-10 13:00-15:00 UTC, plus IAM policy-diff and STS AssumeRole traces. Any required CSV schema?
yvonne (compliance): Auditor prefers CSV manifest with columns: filename, sha256, size_bytes, description. Also a control crosswalk doc linking artifacts to SOC2 CC6 and ISO A.9.
auditor_kb: Yes — CSV manifest + SHA256 lines is ideal. Also need a signed cover note (PDF) stating exports were pulled from immutable logs and checksums match. For RBAC, show policy-before.json / policy-after.json and the ticket that authorized the change.
leo (platform): Splunk query I'll use (AWS example):
```
index=cloudtrail OR index=gcp_audit eventName=CreateGrant OR eventName=RevokeGrant OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=AssumeRole | table _time userIdentity arn eventName requestParameters.keyId requestID sourceIPAddress
```
I'll gzip raw JSON export and produce manifest.csv plus manifest.sha256 (one-line).
evidence_bot: evidence-job queued (job_id=ev-3340-01).
hana (secops): Please include grants with expiry <= 1h (ephemeral) and show grantCreate/grantRevoke pairs. Auditor wants proof TTL enforcement.
leo (platform): Will filter for `grant.expiration - grant.create_time <= 3600`. Also will extract KMS key id (alias and ARN) and key version. Example snippet in export: `{"eventTime":"2026-04-10T13:22:10Z","eventName":"CreateGrant","userIdentity":{"arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-emergency"},"requestParameters":{"granteePrincipal":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ops-emergency","keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1111"}}`
yvonne (compliance): I'll add control-mapping-INC-2026-0410-02.pdf and an attestation.txt (signed). Include the ticket ENG-6743-redacted and PagerDuty link.
auditor_kb: Also include chain-of-custody: who downloaded exports, IP, and timestamp. A small actions.csv is fine.
leo (platform): Added actions.csv with columns user,action,timestamp,ip and set bucket `s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0410-02/` object-lock retention=30d and SSE-KMS with CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-1111.
evidence_bot: object-lock applied to s3://redwood-evidence/INC-2026-0410-02/ (retention=30d).
leo (platform): Upload complete. Objects:
- inc-2026-0410-02-cloudtrail.json.gz (sha256: a1b2...c3d4),
- sts-assumerole-1300-1500.json.gz (sha256: e5f6...a7b8),
- iam-policy-before.json (sha256: c9d0...1111),
- iam-policy-after.json (sha256: f0e1...2222),
- actions.csv (sha256: 55aa...99ff),
- ENG-6743-redacted.pdf (sha256: bbcc...dd44),
- manifest.csv (sha256: 0123...abcd),
- cover-note-signed.pdf (sha256: dead...beef)
Pre-signed URL: https://evidence.redwood.example/s/INC-2026-0410-02.zip?sig=zzzz (expires 7d).
hana (secops): I'll post a short auditor cover note mapping artifacts to SOC2 controls and mark evidence ticket done once KB confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:
auditor_kb: Downloaded and verified SHA256s for manifest and cloudtrail. One follow-up: can you provide the STS AssumeRole sequence for 2026-04-10T13:21:50Z to 13:23:30Z in a separate file? I need the exact request_id order.
leo (platform): Will extract that window and append `sts-window-132150-132330.json.gz` within 2 hours. ETA 11:00 PT.
yvonne (compliance): Adding control narrative now.
auditor_kb: Thanks. If hashes match after the narrow STS file, we can close that control objective.
hana (secops): Thanks team. Keep this thread for any follow-ups and don't modify bucket objects. If auditor requests additional artifacts, we'll run targeted SIEM exports. :handshake:
